method.value: Robust 0.5 maps excluding baselines <300 kλ, primary beam corrected; sources detected above 8σ local rms, plus three tentative at 5σ

evidence.quote: we adopted an 8$\sigma$ threshold for source detection, where $\sigma$ is the local rms noise measured within a radius of $0.5\ensuremath{''}$ of the source
the flux density obtained by fitting a two-dimensional Gaussian function

validation.value: Expected background extragalactic sources estimated as no more than one

evidence.quote: we expect no more than one extragalactic sources in our ALMA field of view.

method.value: Optically thin dust emission with uniform temperature

evidence.quote: assuming that the 1.14 mm dust continuum emission is optically thin and the temperature distribution is uniform.

key_parameters.value: kappa = 2.63 at 263 GHz, beta = 1, Td = 20 K for most sources

evidence.quote: opacity law of (cite: Beckwith1990) with a dust opacity coefficient of $\kappa_\nu=2.63$ cm$^{-2}$ g$^{-1}$ at 263 GHz and a spectral index $\beta=1$.
We adopted a gas-to-dust ratio of 100

validation.value: Opacity uncertainty is a factor of two; T=10/30 K changes masses by 8/3 and 2/3

evidence.quote: The uncertainty in the masses due to an uncertainty in the dust opacity is a factor of two.

method.value: Power-law intensity (q=1.1) model up to R_disk, convolved with beam, fit up to 8 parameters

evidence.quote: with an intensity that is a power-law of the radius ($I_\nu\propto r^{-q}$), up to a maximum radius $R_\mathrm{disk}$, convolved with a Gaussian beam

key_parameters.value: q = 1.1 for all except ALMA 17 (q=1.46); background 0 except ALMA 7 and 8

evidence.quote: we decided to use the same value of $q$ for all the disks, $q= 1.1$, except for ALMA 17.

fitting.value: Halton pseudo-random sampling of parameter space minimizing rms residual

evidence.quote: The fit was performed by sampling the space parameter of dimension up to 8 using a Halton pseudo-random sequence

validation.value: Radii consistent with Gaussian-fit radii via R_G=0.46 R_disk; sizes unchanged within uncertainty when all visibilities used

evidence.quote: the derived disk sizes do not change significantly if all visibilities are included

method.value: Separation distribution function p(s), MST, Q parameter, mass segregation ratio with 1000 random sets

evidence.quote: We take an average over 1000 random sets of $N$ sources in the cluster to estimate $L_\mathrm{norm}$

key_parameters.value: 20 bins, Δs = 2 arcsec; cluster radius 20 arcsec

evidence.quote: We made 20 bins using $\Delta s=2 R_{\rm{GGD27}} / 20=2\ensuremath{''}$

method.value: Scale fluxes to 140 pc and 1.14 mm (alpha=3), compare median radii above sensitivity limit

evidence.quote: We scaled the observed fluxes of GGD 27 to the distance of 140 pc and the fluxes of Taurus, Ophiuchus, and ONC disks to the wavelength of 1.14 mm assuming a spectral index $\alpha=3$.

findings_qualitative.value: Little mass segregation except for the two most massive disks

evidence.quote: Figure [3](#fcluster) shows a dominant $\Lambda_{MSR}$ value of about one, which means no mass segregation or random distribution

claims.hypothesis: GGD 27 disks are smaller than in nearby regions
claims.experiment: Compare flux-size relation and median radii with Taurus, Ophiuchus, ONC
claims.result: Median 34 au vs 92 au (Taurus), 42 au (Ophiuchus), 44 au (ONC)

evidence.quote: Only disk population of Taurus-Auriga differs from the rest.

claims.hypothesis: GGD 27 is a young, subclustered cluster
claims.experiment: MST, Q parameter, mass segregation ratio
claims.finding: Moderate subclustering and no primordial mass segregation suggest youth

evidence.quote: suggest that the cluster of disks is very young, probably associated with Class 0 and Class I low-mass protostars

claims.hypothesis: Disks near the massive star are depleted by external photoevaporation
claims.experiment: Disk mass and radius vs projected distance from MM1
claims.result: Deficit of disks at <0.02 pc, no mass depletion, larger disks only beyond 0.04 pc
claims.finding: No evidence of photoevaporation depletion; deficit near massive star

evidence.quote: disks in the GGD 27 cluster do not display evidence of external photoevaporation due to the massive star

evidence.quote: we expect no more than one extragalactic sources in our ALMA field of view.

limitations_admitted.value: Sample incomplete; faint small disks cannot be excluded

evidence.quote: since we cannot exclude the presence of faint and small disks
